format: canvas-first (L-085): the subject owns the frame height; no diagram-in-panel default. Style bible C13-C17 enforced (content/style-bible.md). One text system per scene (stamps/kinetic titles, L-076). Written BEFORE first keyframe render (G2).

world.palette: V2.P tokens: bgDeep/nebPurple2/nebPurple sky, crust2 rock, amber/lava accent; cool teal/blue ONLY for pressure/air subjects (s4 stamp, s5 ring)
world.time_of_day: tropic night-to-dawn; every scene has a visible light source (lava throat, dawn band, lantern) + vignette + grain
world.character: kip look, cream limbs, navy jacket, teal shoes, amber scarf; rim-lit on every appearance (C14)

scenes.narration: The loudest sound ever: an island that blew itself apart.

visual.prop: Krakatoa island OWNS the frame + blast rings + kinetic title

objects: Krakatoa cone (560px tall, layered silhouette + shaded flank + rim)
scenes.wow: the island itself filling 40% of frame height with the blast rings rolling past it; boat-with-lantern for scale
scenes.text_system: kinetic title THE LOUDEST / SOUND EVER / WAS AN ISLAND (only text)

scenes.narration: In eighteen eighty three, Krakatoa was an island near Java.

visual.prop: island wide shot + '1883' stamp, Java/Sumatra silhouettes at frame edges

objects: Java + Sumatra ridge silhouettes at frame edges
scenes.wow: geographic truth: the strait position — Java and Sumatra silhouettes pinning the island between them

scenes.narration: A hundred miles out, it rated about one hundred eighty decibels.

visual.prop: barograph gauge OWNS the frame — needle slams past + '180 dB' stamp

scenes.wow: the needle physically overshoots and wobbles back — the gauge is hit, not read

scenes.narration: Pain kicks in around one hundred and thirty. This was fifty past it.

visual.prop: giant ear + red-zone arc past the 130 mark, hero small at edge

objects: giant stylized ear (fills frame center, cream shading, ink outline)
scenes.wow: the ear is drawn canal-first — the sound arcs visibly travel INTO it; the 4th arc arrives red
scenes.text_system: 130 dB = PAIN stamp + PAIN ZONE label (one family)

scenes.narration: Forty miles out, over half a ship's crew had their eardrums burst.

visual.prop: ship silhouette OWNS the frame + 'CRACK' stamp, sailors hands to ears

objects: steam ship broadside (hull, deckhouse, funnel, 2 masts, 6 lit portholes)
scenes.wow: ship scale — a 60m steamer drawn 840px wide to feel dwarfed by the sound; portholes lit from inside

scenes.narration: Three thousand miles away, people blamed a nearby ship's cannons.
objects: Rodrigues horizon 3000mi from source (tiny island silhouette)
scenes.wow: scale inversion: the SOURCE is now a 170px speck on the horizon while the sound still arrives

scenes.narration: The pressure wave circled the entire planet. Three and a half times.

visual.prop: globe OWNS the frame — one pressure ring orbiting + '3.5×' stamp

objects: earth globe r=350 (2 continents, cool key light)
teal orbit ellipse + travelling pulse dot (3.5 laps)
scenes.wow: the dot completes exactly 3.5 laps in the scene — the number is felt, not read

scenes.narration: The waves it made killed thirty six thousand people.

visual.prop: dark swell over a village silhouette

objects: rising swell easeIn to +210px over hut tops
scenes.wow: deliberate accent REMOVAL — the only scene with no warm/cool accent; the wave dwarfs the huts scale-wise

scenes.narration: And the island that made the sound was gone.

visual.prop: island splits and sinks into the sea

objects: two island halves separating (split 26px) and subsiding (sink 330px, offset 1.12x)
scenes.wow: the real caldera collapse: the island does not explode — it SLIDES into the hole it blew in itself

scenes.narration: But Earth wasn't finished. A new island rose, the child of Krakatoa.

visual.prop: small sprouting cone island + 'ANAK KRAKATAU' stamp

objects: 2 teal growth rings pulsing (hopeful echo of blast rings)
scenes.wow: the growth rings visually quote the hook's blast rings — same geometry, opposite meaning

scenes.narration: It's been growing for nearly a century, and it could do it all again.

visual.prop: growth rings pulse on the cone + kinetic closer

objects: kinetic closer IT COULD / DO IT ALL / AGAIN.
scenes.wow: frame-0 of the hook and final frame rhyme: same shore-rock pose, same island position, bigger cone

gate_policy: hook_impact scored on FRAME 0 ONLY (boss 2026-11-09); sign-off removed — autonomous publish-or-redesign; G9: any scene reading as 'basic shapes' fails regardless of mean
